label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ inflammatory S100A8/A9 signal)
description: Cluster 0 is a squamous/epithelial cluster in cervical carcinoma, with the epithelial lineage supported by many metagenes: differentiated squamous epithelium (M65, M69, M28, M18, M0) and tumor epithelial states (M32, M42, M20). Top genes CRNN, KLK13, CLCA4, PPL, KLK10, KRT24, PI3, MUC21 and MUC1 confirm a differentiated superficial squamous/mucosal epithelial identity, with basal markers KRT5/KRT14 absent. Neutrophil-like S100A8/S100A9 signal (M0, M70, M28) is substantial in many cells but is non-specific and likely reflects inflammation or neighbouring-cell bleed; it is not treated as a separate lineage. Stress/p53 and SAT1 programs (M54, M61, M21) are diffuse add-ons.
cell_types: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program
initial_label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (+ inflammatory S100A8/A9 signal)
refine_reason: Identity wording differs from the other differentiated squamous clusters (3, 22, 30), which use 'Differentiated squamous epithelium'. Kept the inflammatory S100A8/A9 contamination note.

label: Low-quality cluster, technical signal dominant
description: Cluster 1 is a small (580 cells) cluster with no dominant lineage. Its composition is led by technical and diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, a likely probe or multi-mapping artifact, 14.9% share) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4 cross-hybridization-like background, 11.7%), with the top genes OR4F17, IST1 and SAT1 reflecting the same technical pattern. Weak epithelial hints (KRT8/KRT18 in M30, KRT15/ITGA2 in M10, squamous differentiation genes FLG/CRNN/IVL in M37 at only 1.6%) and a p53/stress program (M54, M16) are present but too small and scattered to define a lineage. Minor myeloid (M14, 1.9%) and NF-kB (M35, 0.9%) signals are background and not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Unclear, low-quality cluster, Squamous epithelial cells

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4 T cells with CD8 subset)
description: Cluster 2 is dominated by T-lineage signal: M29 (T cell markers, 11.2% share, 57% of cells) with CD3E, TRAC, TRBC1/2, CD3D, CD2, CD247, BCL11B, and M83 (Treg markers, 10.5% share, 41% of cells) with FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT, both strongly enriched (fold 51x and 40x). M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, 5% share, 24% of cells) adds a cytotoxic subset. Remaining metagenes (M8, M13, M89, M60, M64, M58, M94, M2) are diffuse nuclear/RNA-processing background with no lineage, and M79, M9, M75 are weak; no meaningful foreign lineage is present. The cluster is mainly CD4 T cells with a regulatory component, with some CD8/cytotoxic cells.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, hypoxic)
description: Cluster 3 is a differentiated, superficial squamous epithelial population. The dominant metagene M37 (18.8% share, 78.9x fold, present in 56% of cells) carries cornification genes (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13), and M15 (cornified envelope genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KLK10) and M69 (CRNN, KLK13, CNFN) support the same identity. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent from these metagenes. M11 adds a hypoxia program (SLC2A1, NDRG1, CA9, 10.7%), and M52 adds a moderate interferon response. The S100A8/S100A9 signal sits mainly inside squamous metagenes (M37, M0) rather than a separate myeloid metagene, so I do not call a distinct contaminating lineage.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells

label: Fibroblasts (weak stromal signal, diffuse background)
description: Cluster 4 is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity background metagenes (M64, M58, M43, M95, together about 20% of counts) with no lineage theme. The only lineage signal is stromal: M4 (fibroblast ECM, COL3A1, SFRP4, LUM, PDGFRA) at 4.1% share and 1.8x fold, M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast, DES, MYH11, TAGLN, CCN2) at 4.0% and 2.6x, and M75 (stromal activation state) at 2.3%. The top genes SFRP4 and CCN2 agree. The stromal share is modest and present in a minority of cells, so the call is weak. No clear foreign lineage is present, and the keratin signal in M30 is too weak to call epithelial contamination.

label: B cells (germinal center-like subset)
description: Cluster 5 is dominated by B-cell identity: M34 (B cell markers, 16.5% share, present in 80.8% of cells, fold 83.9x) carries MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, FCRL1, TNFRSF13C, IRF8 and POU2AF1, and the top genes confirm this (MS4A1 82x, BANK1 84x, CD22 77x, CD79A 34x). M33 (germinal center B cells, 6.4% share, 13.4% of cells, fold 71.6x) adds CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA and RGS13, pointing to a subset of follicular/germinal-center B cells within lymphoid aggregates. Residual diffuse metagenes (M79, M8, M13, M9, M2, M60, M89, M64, M58) are low-specificity background with no lineage, and M75 is a weak stromal stress add-on; no T-cell or myeloid contamination is supported by a strong listed metagene.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Cluster 6 is dominated by squamous epithelial signal. M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium, 11.9% share, present in 47% of cells) and M5 (squamous KRT13/DSP-high, 8.6%) carry the largest shares, and the top genes DSP, KRT13, KRT5, DSG3, DSC2, DSC3, CD24, PERP, SERPINB13 and KLK10 support squamous epithelium, likely cervical tumor or differentiated epithelial cells. The S100A8/S100A9 weight in M0 may reflect myeloid or neighbor bleed, but no listed metagene is annotated as a foreign lineage, so no contamination is called. Basal (M1, M26) and hypoxia (M6, M47) signals are minor add-ons.
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high
refine_reason: Standardized to the shared 'Differentiated squamous epithelium' identity used by other clusters; kept the S100A8/A9-high state qualifier.

label: Fibroblasts (activated, smooth muscle-like add-on)
description: Cluster 7 is a fibroblast-dominated stromal cluster. The main factor M4 (18.5% of counts, present in ~70% of cells, 40x enriched) carries collagens (COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2), SFRP1/SFRP4, LUM, TNC and PDGFRA, and the top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, COL6A1, AEBP1, LUM, COL1A2) confirm a fibroblast identity. Smooth muscle-like contractile genes (M19: DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, 13.8%) and an activated ECM/cancer-associated fibroblast state (M38: POSTN, INHBA, MMP11, 6.1%) add to it. Remaining metagenes are diffuse, low-specificity background (M56, M95, M60, M63, M84, M64, M62, M90, M92) with no clear lineage, and no immune or epithelial contamination is listed.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Smooth muscle-like stromal cells
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte-like signal)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by endothelial identity: M27 (Endothelial cells, 22.2% share, in 66% of cells, >100x enriched) carries VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, PECAM1, KDR, MMRN1, and top genes VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR, PECAM1 confirm vascular endothelium. M25 (pericyte-like NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1% share, 72x enriched) adds a perivascular component, consistent with the endothelial-pericyte pairing of blood vessels, with partial stress/hypoxia qualifiers (EPAS1, FOSL2). Fibroblast metagenes (M4, M38) are minor and not enriched, so no meaningful stromal contamination is called; the diffuse metagenes (M95, M56, M60, M43, M64, M62) are low-share background.

label: Low-quality cells (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster dominated by technical and diffuse factors with no clear lineage: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 13.1%) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4, 10.4%), plus several low-specificity nuclear and housekeeping factors (M45, M56, M60, M8, M95, M22, M85) together make up roughly 38% of counts. The top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15, SMG1, PDE4DIP, USP17L15) are multi-copy or nonspecific. The only lineage signal is weak stromal: fibroblast ECM M4 (3.2%, fold 1.4), smooth muscle M19 (2.6%) and endothelial M27 (1.3%, fold 2.2), each in a minority of cells and not enriched enough to define a population. Likely a low-quality or background-dominated cluster with faint stromal content.
cell_types: Low-quality cells, Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Endothelial cells

label: Low-quality diffuse background (weak squamous epithelial)
description: Cluster 10 is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity factors with no lineage signal: M45 (9.2%), M30 (9.0%), M2 (8.4%), M56 (5.6%), M22 (5.1%) and M60 (4.0%) carry nuclear, splicing and multi-copy or probe-like genes (OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15, GOLGA family, SMG1, ITCH). The only weakly lineage-linked metagenes are M74 (3.7%, TP63/ITGB4/COL7A1, basal squamous hints, in 5% of cells) and M10 (2.1%, KRT15/ITGA2/DSC3, squamous or basal-like), which are small and inconsistent with core basal markers KRT5 and KRT14. The cluster is therefore most likely low-quality background signal, with at most a weak squamous epithelial component. No strong cell type is supported.

label: T cells (+ fibroblast stromal signal)
description: Low-quality cluster dominated by technical and diffuse factors (M30, M2, M8, M56 and M13 together make up about 20% of counts with no lineage). The most enriched lineage signal is T cells: M29 (CD3E, TRAC, GIMAP7, CD2; 28% of cells, 2.9x), M83 (FOXP3, CTLA4, ICOS, IL2RA) and M93 (CD8A, CST7, GZMK, KLRK1). The top genes agree (TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4, CD52, ETS1). Fibroblast stroma signal is present at lower level (M4 ECM factor 3.8%, M19 smooth-muscle/myofibroblast 3.6%, M75 stromal stress 1.8%, with CCN2 and TAGLN among the top genes) and is treated as contamination. Confidence is low because the cluster is noisy and the T-cell share is modest.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 T/NK cells, Regulatory T cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (low quality, weak signal)
description: Cluster 12 is a small, low-specificity cluster. Its only identifiable lineage is squamous epithelium, supported weakly by M0 (7.0% share, squamous/keratinocyte genes KRT13, KRT4, CD24, DSC2), M5 (3.1%, DSP, KRT5, KRT13) and M15 (1.3%, cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP). The top genes agree (IVL, KLK10). Most of the counts come from technical or diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1 artifact, 12.7%) and M2 (multi-copy GOLGA/NBPF genes, 9.8%). NF-kB/TNF inflammatory factors (M35, M36, with CXCL8, IL1A, PPP1R15A) add a small, non-lineage component. Confidence is low.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxia/basal-like state)
description: Twenty cells, a tiny cluster with a squamous epithelial identity. M6 (squamous differentiation, SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, NECTIN4) carries about 25% of counts and is present in 20% of cells, with a hypoxia add-on. M26 (basal keratinocyte program, KRT15, KRT5, TP63, ITGA6) and M80 (TP63, COL17A1, CYP24A1) add a basal-like state. Top genes SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, CTNND1, MUC4 and CYP24A1 support squamous epithelium. Diffuse factors (M45, M87, M82) and technical-like M30 (OR4F17) carry little lineage information, and M36/M35 inflammatory signal is modest, so there is no strong foreign lineage call.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-high, technical signal)
description: Cluster 14 is a small stromal cluster whose identity rests on the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (11.5% share, 5.1x fold, present in 17.8% of cells). The top genes agree: COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, TNC, LUM and AEBP1 are all enriched roughly 4 to 5x. Activated fibroblast factor M38 (COL3A1, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) and smooth muscle factor M19 add a weaker stromal state. Technical or ambiguous factors M30 and M2 (OR4F17, IST1, GOLGA/NBPF families) hold about 31% of the counts and lower confidence, but they carry no lineage. Immune signals (CD8 cytotoxic M93, IgG plasma M3) are small, about 1% each and in few cells, so they are background and not listed as contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (weak, diffuse signal)
description: Diffuse, low-specificity cluster of 36 cells with no dominant lineage. The most coherent signal is a fibroblast ECM program (M4, 7.0% share, 3.1x enrichment, largest in cluster 33), and fibroblast genes (COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1) appear among the top modeled genes. Smooth muscle/myofibroblast (M19), endothelial (M27) and Treg (M83) metagenes each carry only about 3-4% share, which is background-level, so they are noted but not called as contamination. Most top genes (NPM1, STT3B, MBD2, RANBP2) are housekeeping or ER-secretory genes, so identity is weakly supported.
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is most likely basal/reserve squamous epithelium. M1 (basal squamous, KRT5/TP63/DSP) is the largest share and is present in about 36% of cells, and M26 (basal keratinocyte program, KRT15/TP63/ITGA6/ITGB4/LAMB3) adds to this. The top genes KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, LAMB3, ITGA2 and CYP24A1 support a basal epithelial identity, supported by M10 and M80. The cluster is diffuse, with low shares per metagene and no clear foreign lineage; M17 (S-phase) and M36 (NF-kB) are minor add-on programs.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Reserve cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular epithelium/fibroblast mixture
description: Small cluster (24 cells) with no dominant lineage. Epithelial secretory signal is the largest, from M20 (6.2% share, 7.7x enriched, 33% of cells) with MUC1, TMPRSS2, LYPD2, CEACAM7 and PRSS22 among the top genes, plus M54 and M51. Fibroblast ECM signal is comparable, from M4 and M38 (about 9% combined) with COL3A1, COL6A1, COL6A2 and COL5A1 in the top genes. Endothelial and immune metagenes are minor. The remaining metagenes are diffuse or technical (OR4F17, M2, M68). Because the epithelial and stromal shares are of similar size and neither is clearly the cluster's own, this is best read as a mixture, possibly a tumor epithelium-stroma doublet or spillover, with low confidence.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic program (lineage unclear)
description: Proliferating cluster dominated by cell-cycle programs: M7 (histone and mitotic core, 8.5% share, fold 9.9x), M17 (S-phase replication, 7.3%), M39 (G2/M, 3.0%, fold 4.9x), M24 (G1/S, 3.4%) and M41 (mitosis-specific). Top genes are histone (H1-5, H3C2, H2AC8) and mitotic genes (TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A, CENPF, BIRC5). No lineage metagene is strongly enriched; squamous signals (M1 basal keratinocyte at 6.0%, M5 at 3.3% with fold 1.1x, M74) are modest and diffuse, and the cluster is likely cycling tumor or squamous-derived cells. Lineage is therefore only weakly supported, so the label is a cycling state with uncertain lineage.
cell_types: Cycling epithelial cells, Cycling tumor cells, Cycling cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells (noisy, low-signal cluster)
description: Small cluster of 258 cells whose modeled counts are mostly diffuse, technical or ambiguous (M30, M2, M8, M79, M56, M45, M58, M85). The only clear lineage is T cells: M83 (regulatory T cell markers, FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT; 7.2% share, in 38% of cells, 6.4x fold) and M29 (T cell core: CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, BCL11B; 3.3% share, 2.9x fold) lead the lineage signal, with top genes TRAC, CTLA4, CD3E, TRBC1 and TRBC2 agreeing. Weak CD8 cytotoxic signal (M93, 1.6%) suggests some CD8 or NK-like cells. Fibroblast (M4, 3%, 1.3x) and myeloid (M14, 2.2%, 1.3x) metagenes are at background levels and are not treated as contamination. Identity is supported but the signal is weak against a noisy background, so confidence is medium.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (CLEC10A/FCGR2A-high myeloid subset)
description: Cluster is dominated by myeloid signal: M14 (22.1% share, 79.6% of cells, 39x fold) with CSF1R, FCGR2A, CD14, LYZ and FGL2, and M59 (7.8%, 38.3% of cells, 38.8x fold) with C1QA/C1QC, APOE, SPP1, MMP9, CD163 and F13A1. Top genes (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, STAB1) favor a tumor-associated macrophage identity, with M14 as a dendritic-like or inflammatory myeloid add-on. Remaining metagenes (M8, M9, M77, M71, M99, M64, M68) are diffuse, low-specificity background with no lineage signal, and M49 is a shared interferon-gamma program; no meaningful foreign-lineage contamination is present.
cell_types: Tumor-associated macrophages, Myeloid cells, Dendritic cells

label: Fibroblasts (+ IFN-gamma response)
description: Small, diffuse cluster (34 cells) dominated by a stromal ECM signal. Fibroblast metagenes M4 (6.5%) and M38 (5.1%, activated/cancer-associated state) carry COL3A1, COL6A1, COL4A1, SFRP4 and COL5A1, which are among the top enriched genes. The IFN-gamma program M49 (8.7%, CXCL10, CXCL9, STAT1, TAP1, GBP1) is the largest single metagene but is shared across lineages and is not a lineage call. Endothelial M27 (6.0%, fold 10.2x, VWF in top genes) is comparable in share to the fibroblast signal, so some vascular contribution is plausible. Each metagene reaches 10% of counts in only about 6% of cells, so the cell-level evidence is weak.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Endothelial cells, Smooth muscle cells
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, inflamed (sparse cluster)
description: Cluster leans toward differentiated squamous epithelial (likely tumor) cells. M37 (squamous differentiation with inflammatory and hypoxia genes, 6.0%, enriched 9.2x) and M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium, 4.3%) carry the lineage, supported by top genes CRNN, ERO1A, ECM1 and EMP1. Basal markers are absent, so the cells are suprabasal. M45, a diffuse ambiguous factor with 26.8% share, dominates the counts and weakens the call. A cycling signal (M17, 7.5%) and a small tumor-associated macrophage signal (M59, 3.1%, below the contamination threshold) are present, and fibroblast signal is negligible.

label: Fibroblasts (diffuse background, weak identity)
description: Small, low-quality cluster of 40 cells whose best-supported lineage is fibroblasts: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 10.1% share) carries COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1 and COL6A1, and M38 (activated fibroblasts) adds COL3A1, COL6A1 and POSTN. Most of the signal is diffuse housekeeping background (M58 16.7%, M64 9.3%), and M4 is strong in only about 10% of cells. Foreign signal includes a tumor-associated macrophage factor (M59, 7.3%, largest in cluster 20, mostly in one cell) and a small IgG plasma cell factor (M3, 2.1%, IGHG1 among the top genes), which is background-level.

label: Fibroblasts (+ minor T cell signal)
description: Small cluster (39 cells) whose most identifiable lineage is fibroblast/stromal: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers) holds 11.2% of counts with 5.0x enrichment, and the top genes COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1, TNC, COL6A2 and COL5A1 agree. Most of the cluster is diffuse background (M58, M40, M94, M95, M46, M43), so the call is only moderately supported. T-lineage signal is present in a few cells: M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, 5.4%, 9.8x, in 2.6% of cells) and M29 (T cell markers, 4.2%), plus B-cell M34 at 2.7%; these look like doublet or spillover signal in a minority of cells rather than the cluster's own identity.
contaminants: CD8 T/NK cells, T cells, B cells

label: IgG plasma cells (ER stress high)
description: Antibody-secreting plasma cells, mainly IgG-class. M3 (IGHG1, IGKC, XBP1, MZB1, DERL3, PRDM1, IRF4) and M31 (IGHG3, IGHA1, IGLC7, JCHAIN) carry most of the lineage signal, and M23 adds an IGHG2-dominated plasma program. M53 (ER stress/unfolded protein response, HERPUD1, SEC11C, DNAJC3) is the largest share overall and reflects a secretory stress state in most cells. B-cell (MS4A1, CD19) and T-cell (CD3E) markers are absent. The fibroblast factor M4 (3.1%) is small and is ignored.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Activated fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like)
description: Stromal cluster of 35 cells dominated by fibroblast and smooth-muscle-like signal. M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast, DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, MYLK) has the largest share at 13.9%, and M4 (fibroblast ECM, COL3A1, SFRP4, LUM, PDGFRA) and M38 (activated fibroblasts, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) add to it. Top genes CCN2, SFRP4, COL3A1, TAGLN, THBS1, GREM1 and LTBP2 support an activated stromal state. M29 (T cell markers, CD3E, TRAC, BCL11B) reaches 7.4% share but is seen in only about 2 of 35 cells, so it is minor contamination from T cells, mainly from cluster 2. Diffuse housekeeping metagenes (M64, M62, M76, M84, M82) are background.
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: Inflamed squamous epithelial cells (NF-kB response)
description: Small cluster (50 cells) defined mainly by an NF-kB/TNF inflammatory response (M36, 12.3% share; top gene TNFAIP2, with NFKB2, NFKBIZ, NFKBIA, ZC3H12A, BIRC3 and IRF1 in the top genes). The most lineage-informative signal is squamous: CRNN is a top gene (fold 4.5), and M69 (CRNN-high squamous differentiation, fold 4.0) and M37 (squamous differentiation with inflammatory and hypoxia genes, fold 5.9) are enriched, along with M5 (squamous epithelium). No basal markers load strongly, so the cells look like superficial or inflamed squamous epithelium. A minor T-cell signal (M29, 4% share in 6% of cells) is probably background or low-level contamination, so it is noted but not listed.

label: Fibroblasts (activated ECM-remodeling subset)
description: Cluster 28 is a fibroblast cluster. M4 (fibroblast ECM program, 41% of counts, in 81% of cells) and M38 (activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast state, 21%, in 33% of cells) dominate, with top genes COL3A1, COL6A1/2, SFRP1/4, TNC, LUM, COL5A1/2, COL1A2, POSTN and MMP11. Smooth muscle and endothelial markers are absent. Small foreign signals are background: IgG plasma cell M3 (3.3%, 3.7% of cells) and squamous-differentiation M37 (4.5%, 11% of cells) are both under 5% and are noted only here, not as contamination.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling

label: Squamous epithelial cells (+ stromal signal)
description: A very small cluster (29 cells) whose clearest signal is squamous keratinizing differentiation: M37 is the largest-share and most enriched metagene (fold 10.4x), and its top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, SCEL and IVL are among the most enriched in the cluster, with M70 (KRT13, MUC22, KRT78) supporting it. Stromal signal is present at a modest level: fibroblast ECM M4 (4.9%, SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1) and smooth muscle M19 (6.5%, DES, MYH11, TAGLN), together about 11% of counts and in few cells, so treated as contamination. Treg (M83) and CD8 cytotoxic (M93) signal is minor, and most other metagenes are diffuse background, so confidence is low.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, low signal)
description: A tiny cluster (32 cells) whose clearest identity is differentiated squamous epithelium. Squamous differentiation metagenes dominate: M37 (7.5%, enriched 11.6x, with FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL), M15 (cornification genes), M6 and M0 (KRT13, DSC2, DSG3), and M57 (PPL, EMP1). Top genes agree (FLG 11.6x, CRCT1 10.8x, CRNN 3.3x, IVL 3.6x), and ERO1A and S100A8/9 add an inflamed or hypoxic flavour. Lymphoid and fibroblast signals are weak (M4 fibroblast ECM at 3.5% in 6.2% of cells, M79 unresolved). The top gene IGHG1 (4.7x) hints at some plasma-cell or immunoglobulin signal that no metagene captures. Most of the remaining metagenes are diffuse background, so the call is modest.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ T cell and fibroblast contamination)
description: The cluster's own identity is differentiated squamous epithelium. M37 (squamous differentiation, 12.4% share, fold 19.1x) and M15 (cornification genes, 1.9%, fold 3.7x) carry the top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, IL36A, RNASE7 and HEPHL1, with basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 absent. Foreign signal is modest: T cell markers (M29, 7.2% share in 13% of cells) and fibroblast ECM (M4, 6.2% in 10% of cells) are listed as contamination, and IgG plasma cell signal (M3, 1.6%) is background. Only 30 cells, so the call rests on a small sample.
contaminants: T cells, Fibroblasts, IgG plasma cells
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + T cell markers
initial_label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (+ T cell and fibroblast contamination)
refine_reason: Standardized the identity wording to 'Differentiated squamous epithelium' and kept its contamination note.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, superficial)
description: A very small cluster (33 cells) whose lineage signal is weak. The most coherent identity is squamous epithelial differentiation: M37 (6.2% share, 9.5x enriched, present in 12% of cells) carries cornification and granular-layer genes (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL), and FLG, CRNN and ERO1A are among the top genes. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the cells look superficial and inflamed rather than basal. Most of the modeled counts come from diffuse, low-specificity factors (M45, M50, M58, M56, M64) with no lineage. M29 (T cell markers, 4.1% share) and the NF-kB inflammatory program M35 (1.7%) are small, and the T-cell genes are not among the top genes, so they are treated as background rather than contamination.

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-high stroma)
description: Cluster 33 is a small fibroblast population (119 cells, 0.2%) dominated by the fibroblast-core ECM factor M4 (42.3% share, 18.9x fold, present in 92% of cells), with top genes COL3A1, SFRP1/4, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, LUM, COL1A2, TNC and PDGFRA. label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Small stromal cluster dominated by fibroblast ECM signal: M4 (COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1/SFRP4, PDGFRA, CDH11; 42% of its counts in cluster 33) and the activated ECM factor M38 (POSTN, INHBA, MMP11, THBS2, COL3A1). Top genes SFRP4, COL3A1, CCN2, SFRP1, COL6A1, COL5A1 and AEBP1 agree. Smooth muscle (M19) and pericyte-like (M25) factors add a minor vascular-stromal component. label: Squamous epithelial cells (differentiated, low confidence)
description: Tiny cluster of 37 cells whose largest informative signal is the squamous differentiation metagene M37 (6% share, 9.2x fold, in 8% of cells), with cornification genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1 and IVL among the top enriched genes. Supporting weak epithelial evidence comes from the PLAT/KLK10/SERPINB4 tumor epithelial state M42 (1.4%), and fibroblast ECM M4 (4.4%, 1.9x) is a minor component under 5%, so it is noted but not treated as contamination. Most of the cluster is diffuse technical signal (M30, M2, M58), and the IGHG1 and ERO1A signals are modest. The lineage call is tentative because the differentiation program is shared across epithelium and no basal markers (KRT5/KRT14) load here.

label: Squamous differentiation + diffuse background (low confidence)
description: Cluster 36 is small (39 cells) and mostly diffuse. Its largest identity signal is weak squamous differentiation: M6 (6.9% share, 5.1% of cells, hypoxia flavour, SERPINB13/KRT13/DSG3) and M37 (3.6%, 10.3% of cells, FLG/CRNN/IVL with inflammatory genes), with M5 adding a minor squamous component. Most of the share sits in low-specificity background factors (M58, M64, M45, M91, M86, M50) and a technical OR4F17/IST1 factor (M30), and the top genes (GNAS, DAZAP2, CMPK1, TPT1, OR4F17, IST1) are broadly expressed. Other signals are minor: a G1/S program (M44, 5.8%), interferon response (M52, 2.8%), and CD8 cytotoxic T/NK (M93, 2.4%, in 2.6% of cells), all below the contamination threshold. The lineage is therefore only weakly supported, and the squamous call is low confidence.
